stroke.rule: a stroke of at most 500 m each side of the gauge, along the one saved channel line the gauge is associated with; it locates a reading and is not a measured or inferred reach
stroke.from: the Austin creek prototype's gauge-location stroke (data/model/creek-display-policy.json)

contrast.value: largest saved instantaneous reading in the storm window minus the same gauge's seasonal median daily mean
contrast.note: an instantaneous reading beside a daily reference: it shows flow above a usual day and is not a rank of the peak

bands.label: at or below a usual day

band_basis: one band per factor of ten, because the creeks and rivers on this page span five orders of magnitude; the Austin page's linear bands stop at 500 cfs

unavailable.label: no comparison
unavailable.reason: no reading in the window or no qualifying daily reference
